failure_summary.description: Agents returned a related item or formula component instead of the entity described by the clue.
Answers missed exact-match form through over-expansion, added diacritics, or singular/plural mismatch.
A bare comma-separated pair was treated as asking for one member rather than a shared attribute.

patch.reasoning: The skill already advises identifying the requested slot, but the repeated related-entity mistakes suggest an operational check may help agents apply that rule to declarative clues. A bare list of entities is a distinct clue pattern not explicitly covered. Clarifying how to preserve source spelling addresses the diacritic mismatch; no plural-specific edit is proposed because a similar edit was rejected previously.

edits.target: - Treat terse statements, quoted fragments, and incomplete phrases as information-seeking clues when appropriate. Infer the answer slot from the wording, then use the context to identify the entity or value that satisfies the clue.
edits.content: - For a declarative clue, first turn it into a direct one-slot question (for example, “Who is described?” or “What thing has this property?”). Check that the answer fills that slot, rather than naming a component, associated item, or other entity mentioned nearby.

edits.target: - For completion or compound clues, identify the missing shared component that makes the alternatives fit; do not repeat a clue-supplied component or return one full compound. For partial-name prompts, give only the requested unknown name part. Omit components already stated in the question unless they are needed for unambiguous identification.
edits.content: - When a prompt is just a comma-separated list of entities, check whether it is a clue for a shared attribute or relationship. If the context supports one, give that common answer rather than selecting one listed entity.

edits.target: - Use the context-supported conventional form of a name or answer, and include additional name parts only when needed to distinguish otherwise-confusable entities.
edits.content: - For exact-match answers, mirror the spelling used in the question or the clearest relevant context passage when variants appear; do not add diacritics absent from those sources.
